name: Alert
summary: An inline, contextual feedback banner — info, success, warning, or error.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-alert> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; tone is the `type` attribute, the status glyph is summoned BY NAME from the shared icon library, and `closable` adds a dismiss control that animates the banner out on a persistent node and emits a composed `close` event.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper for the composed `close` event; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Box
spec.value: flex row, gap 10 · padding 10 14 · radius 8 · 1px tonal border

spec.label: Icon
spec.value: status glyph via <aha-icon> (system-info / system-check-circle / system-warning-circle / system-x-circle)

props.name: heading
props.desc: Optional bold title above the message

props.name: close
props.desc: Composed event when the banner is dismissed

whenToUse.when: a persistent, inline message tied to a region of the page (a form warning, a page-level notice)
a brief, transient confirmation of an action that then disappears
a richer, stacking message with a title + description, often from a background event

opinion.note: Keep the message to one or two lines; lead with what happened, then what to do. Reserve error for real failures — over-using red trains people to ignore it.
opinion.dsv3: Tones bound to the DS V3 semantic families (bg-informative / bg-positive / bg-warning / bg-negative + matching border + text tokens); radius on the scale (radius-default = 8). The status glyph is a real DS icon summoned by name, never an inline SVG.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

selfCheck.label: closable animates out on a persistent node + emits composed close

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. Probe is the default (info) alert.
